node.title: Re^2: Is foreach split Optimized?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thank you for the link! Taken together with the AM's post [id://1194635|here], it does seem that I was just surprised by the speed of [doc://split], causing me to initially read too much into the commit messages regarding @x = split, like [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/692044df|692044df] and [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commit/5012eebe|5012eebe].
